purpose: Isolate the residual I4C-style middle/late whole-episode craft degradation that remains after scene-entry plan-preface, internal meta-token, and critical-continuity defects are absent.

sealed_outcome_context.use: descriptive association only; cannot create or rewrite quality scores

hypotheses.H_R1_POSITIONAL_GENERICNESS: I4C scene surface becomes more cross-scene-similar or mechanically repeated in middle/late scenes even without explicit plan-preface leakage.
hypotheses.H_R2_DIALOGUE_ECONOMY_VOICE: I4C middle/late scenes show longer/more uniform dialogue and/or reduced speaker lexical differentiation relative to early scenes and/or I4E R2.
hypotheses.H_R3_ACTION_SPECIFICITY: I4C middle/late stage directions contain a lower share of concrete observable-action sentences, leaving more abstract/expository connective tissue.
hypotheses.H_R4_OUTCOME_ASSOCIATION: Within the frozen 12 I4C human-comparison scenes, human-win scenes are descriptively associated with worse values on one or more preregistered craft-drift metrics. Association is not causal proof.

metrics.dialogue_share: dialogue characters / all normalized scene-body characters
metrics.speaker_voice_differentiation: For speakers with >=8 dialogue lines in a tercile, build character-trigram frequency distributions from that speaker's dialogue and compute mean pairwise Jensen-Shannon divergence base2; no speaker-name tokens are added.
metrics.exact_stage_sentence_repetition: Normalize whitespace; split nondialogue stage directions on Korean/ASCII sentence endings; sentences >=15 chars. Repeated-stage-sentence char share counts sentences that occur in more than one scene.
metrics.scene_genericness: For each scene, form a set of character 4-grams from normalized nondialogue stage direction text; compute its maximum Jaccard similarity to another scene. Summarize mean nearest-neighbor Jaccard by tercile.
metrics.observable_action_sentence_share: Stage-direction sentences matching at least one frozen observable-action regex / all stage-direction sentences >=8 chars.
metrics.abstract_explanatory_sentence_share: Stage-direction sentences matching at least one frozen meta-explanatory regex / all stage-direction sentences >=8 chars.
metrics.position_trend: Early/middle/late summaries plus Theil-Sen scene-index slope where a per-scene metric exists.

analysis_plan.same_episode_comparator: Compare I4C_R2 vs I4E_R2 using identical parser/metrics.
analysis_plan.outcome_association: Compare medians for I4C selected candidate-win vs human-win scenes; descriptive only.
analysis_plan.no_threshold: No metric threshold is a PASS/FAIL gate in this retrospective diagnostic.

forbidden_actions: no causal claim from descriptive association
next_after_result: Only after the residual signature is isolated may a fresh prospective renderer intervention be preregistered.
